_meta.notes: Source language. Keep SMS under ~160 characters where possible. Placeholders in {braces}.

alert.medium: FloodGuard {zone}: FLOOD WATCH. Heavy rain. Move valuables up, charge your phone, know your shelter: {shelter}. Need help? SMS HELP to {shortcode} or dial {ussd}
alert.high: FloodGuard {zone}: FLOOD WARNING. Water may enter homes soon. Move children, elderly & sick to higher ground now. Shelter: {shelter}. Trapped? SMS HELP to {shortcode}
alert.severe: FloodGuard {zone}: SEVERE FLOOD. Leave low areas NOW. Go to {shelter}. Do not walk or drive in moving water. Trapped? SMS HELP to {shortcode} or dial {ussd}

voice.medium: This is FloodGuard with a flood watch for {zone}. Heavy rain is falling. Move your valuables to a high place, charge your phone, and know the way to {shelter}. If you need help, send HELP by SMS to {shortcode}.
voice.high: This is FloodGuard with a flood warning for {zone}. Water may enter homes soon. Move children, elderly and sick people to higher ground now. The nearest shelter is {shelter}. If you are trapped, send HELP by SMS to {shortcode}, or dial {ussd}.
voice.severe: This is FloodGuard. Severe flood emergency for {zone}. Leave low areas now and go to {shelter}. Do not walk or drive through moving water. If you are trapped, send HELP by SMS to {shortcode}, or dial {ussd}. Tell us how many people are with you.

level_body.medium: Heavy rain is expected to cause flooding in low areas. Please move valuables, documents and food to a high place. Charge your phone. Agree with your family where you will meet.
level_body.high: Water may enter homes in low-lying areas within hours. Move children, elderly, pregnant women, disabled and sick people to higher ground NOW. Do not wait until the water reaches your door.
level_body.severe: Flooding is happening now. Leave low-lying areas immediately and go to the nearest shelter. Do not walk, swim or drive through moving water — even knee-deep water can sweep you away. Switch off electricity at the main switch if it is safe to do so.

sms.help_ack: FloodGuard: Help request {ref} received ({people} people). Stay on the highest safe point. Rescuers are being sent. Reply anytime with more details.
sms.help_ack_unlocated: FloodGuard: Help request {ref} received. We need your location: reply with your area and nearest landmark (e.g. a market, school or bus stop).
sms.help_merged: FloodGuard: Request {ref} updated ({people} people). Rescuers have the new details.
sms.location_updated: FloodGuard: Thank you. Location for {ref} set near {place}.
sms.rescuer_assigned: FloodGuard: A rescuer ({vtype}) accepted {ref} and is on the way. Stay where you are if it is safe.
sms.rescued_resident: FloodGuard: You are marked RESCUED ({ref}). Nearest shelter with space: {shelter}.
sms.family_safe_rescued: FloodGuard: {name} has been rescued and is safe. Ref {ref}.
sms.safe_ack: FloodGuard: You are marked SAFE. We told your family contacts. If anything changes, SMS HELP to {shortcode}.
sms.safe_ack_closed: FloodGuard: You are marked SAFE and request {ref} is closed. If you still need help, SMS HELP.
sms.report_ack: FloodGuard: Thank you. Report received{place}. It helps rescuers and the flood map.
sms.shelter_info: FloodGuard: Nearest shelter: {name}, {distance} away, space for {space}. Tel {phone}.
sms.shelter_none: FloodGuard: No shelter with space found near you. If you are in danger, SMS HELP to {shortcode}.
sms.unknown: FloodGuard: SMS HELP (e.g. HELP 3 people roof) for rescue, SAFE if you are safe, WATER knee to report flooding, SHELTER for nearest shelter.
sms.stop_ack: FloodGuard: Flood alerts stopped. SMS START to rejoin. You can still SMS HELP anytime.
sms.start_ack: FloodGuard: Flood alerts are ON for your number.
sms.delete_ack: FloodGuard: Your registration and household data were deleted. You can still SMS HELP anytime.
sms.register_ack: FloodGuard: {name} registered in {zone}. Alerts in {language}. SMS STOP to stop alerts, DELETE to erase your data.
sms.job_offer: FloodGuard job {ref}: {people} people, {distance} away, urgency {urgency}. Open the volunteer app to accept within 2 min.
sms.job_cancelled: FloodGuard: Job {ref} was reassigned or closed. Thank you.
sms.otp: FloodGuard volunteer login code: {code}. Valid 5 minutes. Do not share it.

ussd.main:
CON FloodGuard {region}
1. I need help
2. I am safe
3. Report flooding
4. Nearest shelter
5. Register household
ussd.ask_people: CON How many people are with you? Enter a number:
ussd.ask_vulnerable:
CON Anyone elderly, disabled, pregnant, a child under 5 or sick?
1. Yes
2. No
ussd.ask_vulnerable_type:
CON Who needs extra care?
1. Elderly
2. Disabled
3. Pregnant
4. Child under 5
5. Sick/bedridden
ussd.ask_where:
CON Where are you now?
1. At my registered home
2. Choose a landmark
ussd.confirm_help:
CON Send help for {people} people near {place}?
1. Confirm
2. Cancel
ussd.help_done: END Help request {ref} received. Stay on high ground. Rescuers are being sent. We will SMS you.
ussd.safe_done: END Thank you. You are marked SAFE. Your family contacts will be told.
ussd.ask_report_type:
CON What did you see?
1. Water in homes/streets
2. Road blocked
3. Drain blocked
ussd.ask_depth:
CON How deep is the water?
1. Ankle
2. Knee
3. Waist
4. Chest or higher
ussd.report_done: END Thank you. Your report helps rescuers.
ussd.shelter: END Nearest shelter: {name} ({distance}). Space for {space}. Tel {phone}
ussd.shelter_none: END No shelter with space found. If you are in danger SMS HELP to {shortcode}.
ussd.reg_name:
CON Register household.
Enter your name:
ussd.reg_lang:
CON Preferred language:
1. English
2. Pidgin
3. Hausa
4. Yoruba
5. Igbo
ussd.reg_vulnerable:
CON Anyone at home needing extra care?
1. Elderly
2. Disabled
3. Pregnant
4. Child under 5
5. Sick/bedridden
0. None
ussd.reg_family: CON Family phone to tell when you are safe (0 to skip):
ussd.reg_consent:
CON FloodGuard stores your phone, area & household needs ONLY to warn and rescue you. SMS DELETE anytime to erase.
1. I agree
2. Cancel
ussd.reg_done: END Registered. You will get flood alerts for {zone}.
ussd.invalid: END Invalid choice. Please dial {ussd} again.

alert_subject.severe: SEVERE FLOOD — leave low areas in {zone} now

email.safe_rescued: {name} has been rescued by a FloodGuard volunteer and is safe (reference {ref}).
email.safe_checkin: {name} checked in as SAFE with FloodGuard at {time}.
email.footer: You receive this because you registered with FloodGuard. SMS STOP to {shortcode} to stop alerts, or DELETE to erase your data.
email.verify_subject: Confirm your email for FloodGuard alerts
email.verify_body: Hi {name}, you signed up for FloodGuard flood alerts for {zone}. Confirm this email address so we can send you warnings here as well as by SMS.
email.verify_ignore: If you did not sign up, ignore this email — nothing will be sent to you.
